title: Extinction and Survival for a Generalized Contact Process with Deterministic Cures
summary: We study a generalized contact process on \(\mathbb{Z}^d\) parameterized by an infection rate \(λ\) and a resetting probability \(p \in [0,1]\), modeling deterministic cure times. Once a vertex is infected, its recovery is scheduled exactly one time unit later. Incoming attempts to an already-infected vertex successfully reset its recovery clock with probability \(p\), and are ignored otherwise. This unifies spatial versions of classical Type I (\(p=0\), non-paralyzable) and Type II (\(p=1\), paralyzable) counters.
